name: agtx
where_agents_run: your machine, one tmux window and git worktree per task; optional Docker sandbox; phone browser over wifi or Tailscale
source_note: The upstream project. Checked against its README, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, LICENSE, install.sh, Cargo.toml, agent source, phone web app source and the v1.0.6 release. Not the thereal4th/AGTX fork, which stopped at the March 2026 code. Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Nine coding agents on one kanban board

harness_count.value: 9: Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, Cursor, Grok, Antigravity, pi

needs_you_signal.value: Blocked badge with the reason; no desktop alert

approve_deny_prompt.value: Type answers into the agent's terminal, phone included

cross_provider_delegation.value: Different agent per phase, switched on the same task

conversation_gui_view.value: Popup and phone show the live terminal, not a chat

real_terminal.value: Live pane in a popup or fullscreen; tmux attach

session_organization.value: Kanban per project, dependency graph, project sidebar

prompt_scratchpad.value: Backlog task text waits until you start it

saved_prompt_library.value: Per-phase prompt templates in plugins; no free library

builtin_editors_browser.value: Built-in diff view and config editor; no code editor

appearance_control.value: Theme colors with live preview; font is your terminal's

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Opens a GitHub pull request at Review; no issue intake

worktree_management.value: Every task gets its own worktree

planner_orchestrator.value: Plans work in waves and merges it; orchestrator in beta

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Board-running session reads and messages task agents

knowledge_base.value: Board carries specs, plans and diffs to dependent tasks

native_mobile_app.value: Installable web app instead of a store app

phone_no_new_app.value: Phone browser over wifi or Tailscale, paired by QR

os.value: macOS, Linux; phone browser; Windows only via Docker sandbox

app_shell.value: Terminal UI (Rust, ratatui) over tmux; phone web app

background_process.value: Yes: its own tmux server; web server only while serving

download_size.value: v1.0.6: 4.4-4.9 MB archives for macOS and Linux

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Tiny (estimate: one Rust binary plus tmux)

license_cost.value: Apache-2.0, free; uses your own agent subscriptions

extensibility.value: TOML workflow plugins, custom skills, MCP server
